_comment: Optional. Daisho writes its own ocr_settings.json on first run, so you do not need this file. Copy it to ocr_settings.json only if you want to pre-seed settings. Leave japreader_path empty: the app finds the reader it built under study/japReader/out/.
_comment_verification: Off by default. 'always' requires a local Ollama server running the model below; without Ollama, leave this off.
_comment_japreader: Leave japreader_path empty and the app auto-detects the reader it built. japreader_ichiran_command is only used once you have run setup_ichiran_wsl.ps1.
